about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: A passionate journey from software engineering to cybersecurity
about.p1: I'm Tales Lima de Paula, a cybersecurity student and experienced software developer based in Luxembourg. My path into technology began at 42 Luxembourg, one of Europe's most rigorous software engineering schools, where I spent years mastering low-level programming, algorithms, and systems architecture through an intensive peer-to-peer learning model — no teachers, no classes, just pure problem-solving.
about.p2: After graduating from 42, I entered the blockchain industry as a developer, designing and deploying decentralized applications and smart contracts on Ethereum. This role deepened my understanding of secure distributed systems, cryptographic principles, and the critical importance of code security in financial applications — where a single vulnerability can have catastrophic consequences.
about.p3: My time in blockchain naturally led me to my current passion: cybersecurity. I'm now pursuing a Cybersecurity degree at Unigran Europa in Brussels and a specialized Cybersecurity program at DLH Academy in Luxembourg. My interests span web application security, network security, penetration testing, threat modeling, and vulnerability assessment. I believe understanding how systems are attacked is the best way to learn how to defend them.

journey.title: My Cybersecurity Journey
journey.subtitle: From software engineering roots to a dedicated cybersecurity professional
journey.step1Desc: Began an intensive software engineering program at 42 Luxembourg, mastering C, C++, algorithms, Unix systems, and full-stack development through relentless project-based learning. This experience built a deep technical foundation and a problem-solving mindset that underpins everything I do today.
journey.step2Desc: Joined the blockchain industry as a developer, building decentralized applications and smart contracts on Ethereum. Gained hands-on experience with Solidity, Web3 security, tokenization, and DeFi protocols — learning that financial code demands near-perfect security practices.
journey.step3Desc: Fascinated by how systems are exploited and secured, I committed to a career in cybersecurity. Began self-study through TryHackMe, HackTheBox, and Cybrary, earning early certifications and discovering a passion for penetration testing and vulnerability research.
journey.step4Desc: Enrolled simultaneously in a Cybersecurity degree at Unigran Europa (Brussels) and a Cybersecurity Specialization at DLH Academy (Luxembourg). Actively studying network security, ethical hacking, digital forensics, threat modeling, and incident response.
journey.step5Desc: Targeting roles in penetration testing, security consulting, or red team operations. Long-term aspiration: to contribute to building more secure digital ecosystems and help organizations identify and eliminate vulnerabilities before attackers can exploit them.
